privacy.title: Asiyiqokeleli okanye siyigcine inombolo yakho yefowuni yobuqu
privacy.content: Ukukhusela ubumfihlo bakho, inkampani yethu ayigcini igama, idilesi okanye inombolo yefowuni yakho, kwaye asiqokeleli iinombolo zeefowuni. Abathengi nabancedisi bayanxibelelana ngokukhuselekileyo ngale vebhsayithi okanye usetyenziso lwe-LIFE.HELP. Imbali yakho yokusebenzisa inkonzo igcinwa kwisixhobo sakho kuphela, kwaye ukuba utshintsha izixhobo, imbali yokusetyenziswa kwisixhobo sangaphambili ayinakudluliselwa kwisixhobo esitsha.
privacy.cardZeroPhoneDesc: Inombolo yakho yefowuni yangempela ayiqokelelwa okanye ayigcinwa, ukuqinisekisa ukuba akukho spam okanye ingozi yokuvuza.
privacy.cardRealtimeChatDesc: Thumela imiyalezo ngolwimi lwakho lwenkobe, itoliwe ngokuzenzekelayo ibe sisiKorea kubancedisi.
